{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter out QC-failure sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Filter for severe disease
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL)
mean_baseline_severe = df_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_baseline_severe"}
